final: WITH equipment_averages AS (SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipment_reference, AVG(se.humepct) AS average_humidity FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN scanenvironment se ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry GROUP BY e.equipregistry), above_average AS (SELECT * FROM equipment_averages WHERE average_humidity > (SELECT AVG(average_humidity) FROM equipment_averages)), reference_averages AS (SELECT (SELECT AVG(average_humidity) FROM equipment_averages) AS all_equipment_average, (SELECT AVG(average_humidity) FROM above_average) AS above_group_mean) SELECT aa.equipment_reference, aa.average_humidity, aa.average_humidity - ra.all_equipment_average AS excess_over_all_equipment_average, aa.average_humidity - ra.above_group_mean AS difference_from_group_mean FROM above_average aa CROSS JOIN reference_averages ra WHERE ra.all_equipment_average IS NOT NULL AND ra.above_group_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
